about: Signature behaviours held after their picture strips were looked at (lane SIG2, 2026-11-23): each row stays in its own data file and is never drawn or told in the log until a fix shows it clearly. Read by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts. Strips: ~/AnimalDex-work/sig2/. SIG3 (2026-11-23): seven tree and ground huddles released, and the Russian and Sulcata tortoises' dig_burrow (the SIG2 harness had looked for a recipe named `dig_burrow~tortoise`, which no template has) after the sleep layer seated a huddling group at its leader's roost (strips ~/AnimalDex-work/sig3/mam/). SIG3 tranche 2: the doves' display_flight released (a `sky` target over the treetops; strips ~/AnimalDex-work/sig3/t2/).

held.reason: SIG3 (members now seated at their leader's limb): the 0.23 m marmosets sit where the limb meets the trunk and are drawn half inside the wood SIG3 tranche 2: tried seating the members along the limb (the map point's tangent) out from the leader: the group's sleeping bodies are then drawn onto the same spot (gaps 0.01-0.08 body lengths for lemur, capuchin, stump-tail), so it was reverted; the marmoset's and long-tailed macaque's leaders sleep on a point whose roost carries no limb heading, and their frames were unchanged. SIG3 tranche 3: the huddle now faces one way across its limb (the map point's heading), but the five still sit round a thick sloping limb, some under it and two on a thinner branch beside it; seating them along the limb itself put the lemurs past its end two on one spot, so the seats were left as they were. Switched off in the sleep layer (each sleeps a little apart) until it reads.

four drawn inside each other (gap 0) on a cliff face, a fifth 6 m off: a merged blob, not a huddle (unchanged by SIG3: the leader's cliff spot, not a map roost) SIG3 tranche 3: switched off in the sleep layer (each sleeps a little apart) until it reads.

the episode is freeze/scan/walk with no dash or snap; the wall clingers' sit-and-wait (micro-ambush.ts) runs only for micro-placed animals, and on the live v2 map a gecko perches (map/place.ts: not trueMicro), so it never plays there; the harness's micro shot crashed for the same reason SIG3: and the template's snap takes an ambient insect (catch: insect, a catch the engine never made: no fake events, decisions 489/491); the honest way is the `dash` hunt act on a real server meal (hunt-acts.json maps all eight to `dash`, not yet in LIVE_HUNT_ACTS). In the day harness the dash never starts either: its run fails the minute turn budget (the turn home after the dash plus the slot's last turn over 5.4 rad). SIG3 tranche 2 (22:00 WIB, hunting at full since 21:41): no gecko or lizard has a server meal or escape yet (0 ever, though their food links have insect prey aboard); the `dash` act's harness frames (freeze, dash, eat) read for the house gecko, not cleanly for the wolf spider. Not made live until a real gecko meal is seen to drive it.
